normalization.overview: Guillermo Rauch describes recursive founder mode, reusable skills, hiring review and V as a common entry point to specialist company agents in an interview with Knuckle Up with Nakul.
normalization.whyItMatters: Useful for teams organizing shared agent work. Watch the ownership and routing passages; skip the long interview if you need independently measured organizational outcomes.
normalization.ghostMeshTakeaway: Make the accountable owner and permission scope visible at each destination. Compare a shared entry point with an ordinary workflow on a bounded nonproduction task.
normalization.falsification: Reconsider the recommendation if a controlled comparison on the stated task shows no benefit, or exposes permission failures, omitted evidence or greater cost than the ordinary workflow. See the original article for its specific proposed controls.
